title: Making 768 servers look like 1
summary: This article from PlanetScale reveals how they built infrastructure to make 768 database servers operate as a single logical database, leveraging Vitess technology to handle massive horizontal scaling while maintaining database simplicity and developer experience.
problem_solved: Solving database horizontal scaling challenges by making hundreds of servers appear as one unified database.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how modern database infrastructure can achieve massive scale without complicating the developer experience or requiring manual sharding.
